messages.text: Hey team! For Day 2 in Anuradhapura, make sure everyone brings thick socks for the temples, the stones get boiling hot by 11 AM.
Remember that ATMs in Ella run out of cash frequently during peak weekends. Advise the group to withdraw in Kandy.
For the safari on Day 3, Minneriya was crowded so our driver took us to Hurulu Eco Park instead and we saw dozens of elephants!
In Maafushi, recommend the group to pay local excursions in USD cash, card payments have a 3.5% surcharge everywhere.
The scenic train from Nanu Oya to Ella was delayed by 40 minutes, keep the van driver on standby just in case.
